# Khronos glTF-Validator (vendored)

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gltf-validator (`2.0.0-dev.3.10`)
Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Validator

`gltf_validator.dart.js` is the official Dart→JS build. The host runs it in
`JavaScriptCore` (`Shared/GLTFValidator.swift`) after first paint. See `LICENSE`
and `NOTICES` in this folder.
